explanation: This fires only at the GO step right after a trial where the agent chose a1, landed in S2 by a rare transition, and got rewarded (the D1 says rewarded). It is about 10 if the agent picks a1 again and about 1-5 if it switches to a2; it is 0 at every other step, including after a1 to S1 common, after unrewarded trials, and after a2 to S1 rare even when rewarded.
